summary: Blueprint 19 (Digital Twin Core) — Full stack verified. Backend: 16/16 pytest cases pass covering auth guards, overview, capture-session lifecycle (start → add room → add measurement → complete), the CRITICAL conflict engine (manual value NOT overwritten by lower-reliability photo_detected value, conflict is raised and listed), all 4 resolution paths (keep_existing / use_new / manual / unknown), room-context read, and admin settings/metrics/queue (403 for non-admin, 200 for admin, threshold + capture-type toggle persist). Frontend: mobile viewport user flow works end-to-end — Home Intelligence → hi-twin → twin overview → twin-start-capture → ct-walkthrough → twin-begin → tr-name/tr-add → measurement (tm-label/tm-val/tm-add) → twin-complete returns to overview with updated counts. Conflict banner (twin-conflicts) appears when a conflict exists; conflicts screen renders keep/use/manual/unknown buttons and successfully resolves via 'Use new value' (list emptied). Admin console at /admin → admin-nav-twin loads TwinModule with stat cards, capture-type toggles (tw-type-*), conflict threshold input + tw-threshold-save (persisted 0.10 → 0.12), confidence + source distribution pills, and processing queue. All acceptance criteria met — including the critical rule that a lower-reliability new measurement never silently overwrites a user-confirmed value.
action_items: Optional: In frontend/app/home-intel/twin/capture.tsx, when capture_type is 'walkthrough' the measurement is sent with source_status='manual'. Spec calls walkthrough a distinct source; consider sending source_status='walkthrough' for walkthrough sessions and reserving 'manual' for the explicit Manual entry type. Backend already supports both. Not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: digital_twin_engine.py:277 — diff uses max(prev, 1e-6); safe against zero, no negative-value handling needed since measurements are physical lengths. Fine.
digital_twin_engine.py:281 — condition `prev_rank >= new_rank` correctly ensures lower-reliability new evidence never overwrites; matches spec.
SOURCE_RANK: 'walkthrough' is ranked 30 (same as photo_detected). Acceptable per spec (both are early evidence).
seed_data_creation: Created (via demo_home user): capture sessions with rooms 'UITest_LivingRoom', 'UITest_Bedroom', 'TEST_*_' variants; measurements 'UITest_NorthWall', 'UITest_EastWall' (resolved); dt_settings.conflict_threshold left at 0.12 after admin UI test — main agent may want to reset to 0.10 if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is the public URL in /app/frontend/.env. Login via /auth?mode=login, click [data-testid=auth-submit-button], wait for localStorage['diyhomie_token'] before navigating to protected screens. Backend routes: /api/hi/twin/* (user), /api/hi/admin/twin/* (admin). Conflict engine key rule: manual value must NOT be overwritten by photo_detected; a conflict document is inserted and returned in the POST /measurements response body under 'conflict'.
